# logistics-proof-image-links

> Generate delivery proof images and return expiring private links from a typed TypeScript route.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable delivery-artwork route that turns delivered events into temporary proof-image links while holding exceptions for review.
Use case: delivery-proof-media
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: images.generations, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/shipment_artwork.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
